summary.headline: All six spans are sound and the tiling of Ezek.12.26-Ezek.14.23 is exact (3+9+7+7+11+12 = 49 verses, no gap, no overlap). Five of six confidence levels stand. Every challenge is about a stated ground or an undisclosed device, and in two rows about a claim the witness does not support.
high: P02-019 (Ezek.14.1-14.11): the pe recorded at MT 14:1 marks a division AFTER that verse, separating it from the word-event at MT 14:2; the row reads it twice as corroborating 14:1 as its own head and makes that one of two grounds for high. The previous mark is a samekh at MT 13:19, so the witness's paragraph is MT 13:20-14:1 and the mark is continuity evidence toward what precedes. Span stands on the text signal (the elders' scene answered at 14:3); confidence moves to medium.

P02-020 (Ezek.14.12-14.23): the rejected alternative denies any messenger onset at 14:21, but 14:21 opens with the messenger formula and is a counted member of the 122-verse census. Separately, the utterance signature at 14:16, 14:18 and 14:20 is oath-internal and none of those verses ends on it (only 14:14 and 14:23 do), while the row records all four as verse-final closes. Span still holds - the formula at 14:21 is subordinated by its opening conjunction and the address does not change - so decision keep, on corrected grounds.
medium: P02-015 (Ezek.12.26-12.28): a 40-character byte-identical run plus the identical verse-final utterance signature is shared by Ezek.12.25 and Ezek.12.28, straddling the row's own onset seam; the row instead states both sides are formula-clean. Mandatory continuity disclosure omitted. Keep; high survives.

P02-016 (Ezek.13.1-13.9): Ezek.13.8 ends verse-finally on the counted utterance signature and is recorded only as a messenger formula, so the confidence reasoning names the 13:9 divine-name variant as the whole of the close evidence. Medium is the right level but rests on the device-less onset at 13:10, not on 13:9. Confidence stands.

P02-017 (Ezek.13.10-13.16): the only strict-form recognition close in Ezekiel 13 falls at Ezek.13.14, inside this row, and no recognition device is named at all, though the three uncounted variants at 13:9, 13:21 and 13:23 are each disclosed elsewhere in the corpus. Keep - the wall verdict runs on to its addressee at 13:16.
low: P02-018 (Ezek.13.17-13.23): no word-event formula in any of the three counted forms (39/41/7) falls between MT 13:1 and MT 14:2, so the set-your-face opening at 13:17 is a sub-onset inside the word-event opened at 13:1, and the shared frame is not disclosed. Every other piece of the row's evidence verifies exactly. Keep.
